re_adjudication_note: Re-adjudication of a LANDED PASS. No re-run, no re-queue, no manifest/claim/index edit. Commissioned as a follow-on to failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-708_2026-07-19 (REE_assembly e0ebcbcecc), which established that stale-E3-diagnostics replication is ARM-DEPENDENT and therefore directional rather than merely an inflated n. The commissioning chip SUPERSEDED an earlier chip whose invariance argument was wrong; this document finds the superseding chip also partly wrong, in the opposite direction -- see chip_corrections.
chip_corrections: The commissioning chip inherited 708's 'stale latch' framing. 699 is NOT a stale-latch case: last_score_diagnostics is wholesale REASSIGNED at ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:2452 with f_eligibility_demotion_active pre-seeded False (:2511), and _go_nogo_eligibility_gate (:1145) is invoked at :2878, i.e. AFTER that reassignment, so its keys are absent (-> False via diag.get) on any E3 tick where the gate does not fire. Diagnostic VALUES are fresh per E3 select(). The defect is pure per-env-step RE-READ (hold-duration replication), not staleness. This distinction matters because it is what makes the exactly-1.0 active_frac readings informative rather than vacuous.

The chip read f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac == go_nogo_active_frac == 1.0 as 'the same n_diag == n_ticks saturation signature 708 cites'. Given the per-select reassignment above, exactly 1.0 is the OPPOSITE of a latch artifact: it requires the gate to have fired on EVERY E3 tick in the window. The C1e/C1f active-frac gates are therefore sound.

The chip's central claim -- that the primary DV path 'is NOT what validate_experiments flags ... so it is an additional, unflagged exposure' -- is CORRECT and is the load-bearing finding of this document. The chip was right about where to look and wrong about the mechanism at the readiness gates.

The chip asserts a corrected re-run needs a NEW EXQ NUMBER 'since clearing the latch changes the statistics and makes it a different experiment'. This document DISAGREES and recommends an alphabetic suffix (V3-EXQ-699b). CLAUDE.md's EXQ versioning rule is explicit that 'bug fix = the scientific question is unchanged but the implementation was wrong (broken instrumentation, ...)' takes a letter, and 'when in doubt: new letter'. The 708 precedent used 708a for exactly this class of instrument repair. The chip's 'changes the statistics' reasoning was authored to justify keeping the 699a re-run FAITHFUL, not to govern the naming of a corrected successor.

defect.empirical_confirmation: selected_class_entropy_nats == committed_class_entropy_nats EXACTLY on all 12 arm-seeds, to 6dp. The line-913 latch (a per-selection quantity) and the line-882 executed action (a per-step quantity) collapse to the identical statistic, which is what per-env-step replication of a held selection produces. It also means the run's secondary class readout carries ZERO independent information.
defect.why_the_primary_DV_is_the_exposure: committed_class is not a diagnostic latch at all -- it is the argmax of the action actually executed, so as a measure of behavioural OCCUPANCY it is genuine. The defect is construct mismatch: the driver's own framing (lines 88-97) is that 'the levers move WHICH CLASS is committed (the committed-class axis)', a per-COMMITMENT construct, and MECH-448/449 both act at SELECTION. Reading the class once per env step weights each commitment by its hold duration, so the DV silently becomes selection-diversity convolved with perseveration-duration. Neither lever claims to act on hold duration.

c1_invariance.verdict: C1 HOLDS. The readiness gates are threshold-invariant to the replication, so the PASS stands.
c1_invariance.c1e_c1f_floors_are_zero: excluded_count_floor = 0.0 and nogo_suppressed_floor = 0.0 (result.decision_rule_thresholds). A strictly-greater-than-zero test is invariant to replication in BOTH directions: duplication cannot manufacture a positive from an all-zero genuine record, nor suppress a genuine positive to exact zero. This is precisely 708's own secondary-findings invariance argument. Measured 14.814623 and 0.694637 against 0.0.
c1_invariance.active_frac_gates_saturate: demotion_active_frac_floor = 0.8 and nogo_active_frac_floor = 0.8; measured EXACTLY 1.0 on every armed arm-seed. Because the diag dict is reassigned per select() with the demotion key pre-seeded False and the go_nogo keys absent-unless-fired, a hold-weighted frac of exactly 1.0 requires the gate to have fired on EVERY E3 tick in the window. Invariant.

c1_invariance.note_on_the_699a_queue_note: The 699a queue entry justifies C1 survival with 'the load-bearing readiness gates are RATIOS and MEANS ..., which are invariant under uniform replication'. That premise is false (708 established replication is arm-dependent, not uniform) and the conclusion is right for the two different reasons above. The note must not be reused as authority.

composition_verdict.verdict: DOES NOT SURVIVE. Unlike 708, a plausible correction flips it.
composition_verdict.gate_rule: COMPOUND requires d_both >= max(d_dem, d_gng) + COMPOSITION_MARGIN(0.05) AND d_both >= COMPOSITION_LIFT_MARGIN(0.05), on >= COMPOSITION_MIN_SEEDS(2) of 3 seeds. Shipped: n_seeds_compound 2, n_seeds_cancel 0, n_seeds_neutral 1 -> levers_compound.
composition_verdict.flip_requirement: Seed 42 is already neutral, so killing EITHER remaining compound seed drops n_seeds_compound to 1 < 2 and the verdict becomes NEUTRAL (not CANCEL).
composition_verdict.which_rule_binds_under_the_predicted_cor: The max-rule slack is INVARIANT to a common shift in e_off, because d_both, d_dem and d_gng all shift by the same amount when e_off moves. So an e_off-only correction binds exclusively on the ABSOLUTE lift floor d_both >= 0.05. Required correction: e_off under-estimated by > 0.114708 nats (seed 44) or > 0.134290 nats (seed 43); equivalently e_both over-estimated by the same amounts.
composition_verdict.headroom_makes_that_correction_reachable: e_off(43) = 0.511174 against an effective 2-class ceiling ln2 = 0.693147 -> 0.181973 nats of headroom, against a 0.134290 requirement. e_off(44) = 0.909687 against a 3-class ceiling ln3 = 1.098612 -> 0.188925 nats of headroom, against a 0.114708 requirement. Both required corrections sit INSIDE the available headroom. Additionally e_both(43) = 0.695464 is already at its effective two-class ceiling (counts 5821/5365 plus two singletons), so under de-weighting it can only FALL -- which pushes the same direction.
composition_verdict.contrast_with_708: 708's route survived because its two failing seeds were 0.26 and 0.37 nats short, 'which no de-duplication correction can supply'. Here the requirement is 0.11 to 0.13 nats against 0.18 to 0.19 nats of headroom. The arithmetic runs the other way.

directionality.verdict: The contamination is ALIGNED WITH THE HYPOTHESIS, which is why the finding cannot be salvaged as 'imprecise but directionally right'.
directionality.argument: ARM_OFF is the reference arm for every delta. If the unarmed agent perseverates more -- the expected consequence of removing two selection-perturbing levers, and the same MECH-093 arousal coupling 708 invokes -- then OFF's holds are systematically longer, its occupancy entropy is systematically depressed relative to its per-commitment entropy, and EVERY d_* is inflated, d_both included. The measured bias therefore points the same way as the hypothesis under test and cannot be separated from it by any analysis of the recorded aggregates.
directionality.corroborating_but_not_decisive: ARM_OFF carries the lowest committed-class entropy in 2 of 3 seeds and the fewest unique committed classes in seed 43 (2, vs 4 on ARM_BOTH). This is consistent with the perseveration mechanism, but it is equally consistent with the levers genuinely increasing diversity -- which IS the confound, stated precisely.
directionality.why_the_663_sub_1pct_measurement_does_no: Session mech-279-evidence-confirm-8f3087 (2026-07-20T06:25Z, ree-v3 5433e3ab1c) MEASURED this defect's cost on the v3_exq_663_modulatory_channel_routing driver by matched replay: +0.01% / +0.64% / -0.87% on route_range_mean, sub-1% and sign-varying, so 662/663's point estimates and PASS stand. That result is real and must NOT be generalised to 699, for three reasons. (1) DIFFERENT STATISTIC CLASS: 663's DV is a continuous magnitude read at the selection site, and replicating a value leaves its mean essentially unchanged; 699's DV is an ENTROPY over a class histogram, where replication reweights the distribution itself -- precisely the operation entropy is sensitive to. (2) DIFFERENT ARM SYMMETRY: 663's replication is near-uniform across arms and cancels in the contrast; 699's arms differ in HOLD DURATION, the very quantity doing the weighting, so it does not cancel and is aligned with the effect. (3) DIFFERENT MAGNITUDE RELATIVE TO THE MARGIN: 663's artifact is 1-2 orders of magnitude BELOW the +12-25% cross-class gaps under test, whereas 699's flip needs only 0.115-0.134 nats against entropies of 0.51-1.10 nats, i.e. roughly 12-26% -- 1-2 orders of magnitude ABOVE the 663 artifact scale. 663 measured the artifact where it CANCELS; 699 sits where it does not. The 663 replay is nonetheless the right instrument: routing requirement 3 asks 699b to run the same matched-denominator comparison and settle this by measurement rather than argument.
directionality.what_cannot_be_established: The replication factor itself is NOT observable from the manifest. n_p2_ticks (seed 44: 525 / 1737 / 461 / 707, a 3.8x span) counts ENV STEPS and is driven by episode termination, not directly by E3 cadence. So the arm-dependent EXPOSURE the chip cites is real as a step-count fact but does NOT by itself demonstrate an arm-dependent replication factor. The honest statement is that the weighting is unobservable and the contamination unbounded, not that a specific distortion has been measured.

recoverability.what_survives: per-arm-seed scalar aggregates only (committed_class_entropy_nats, committed_class_counts, n_p2_ticks, the active-frac and mean diagnostics).
recoverability.structural_reason: Ran on ree-cloud-1 under Phase 3; cloud workers POST only manifest_bytes, so even a DECLARED per-tick sink is not transported. Thrice-confirmed now (785, 708, 699).
recoverability.consequence: The entropy cannot be recomputed over fresh-selection rows, and the replication factor cannot even be estimated. A corrected re-run is required to answer 699's question.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: RE-ADJUDICATED 2026-07-20 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-699_2026-07-20), following the stale-E3-diagnostics corpus audit and the V3-EXQ-708 precedent. WHAT STANDS: the PASS. The single load-bearing criterion is C_READY (levers engaged and substrate exercisable), and all seven readiness preconditions survive the defect on threshold-invariance grounds -- the C1e/C1f non-vacuity floors are literally 0.0 (measured 14.81 excluded-count and 0.69 suppressed-per-tick), and a strictly-positive test cannot be manufactured from an all-zero record; the active-frac and frac_pre_ge2 gates read EXACTLY 1.0, which given the per-select reassignment of last_score_diagnostics (e3_selector.py:2452, demotion key pre-seeded False at :2511; go_nogo keys set at :1292 from a gate invoked at :2878, i.e. after the reassignment) requires the gates to have fired on every E3 tick. Both levers demonstrably did real work. WHAT DOES NOT STAND: the levers_compound composition finding, which is WITHDRAWN. The primary DV committed_class_entropy_nats is accumulated at driver line 882/899 from int(action[0].argmax()) on the action RETURNED by agent.select_action, once per ENV STEP; on a non-E3 tick agent.py:5430 returns the HELD action before e3.select() is reached. The DV is therefore hold-duration-weighted OCCUPANCY entropy, whereas the driver's own construct (lines 88-97, 'the levers move WHICH CLASS is committed') and both claims act at SELECTION. This is NOT the exposure validate_experiments lints (that is the separate last_score_diagnostics read at line 929) and was unflagged. The weighting is arm-dependent and, critically, ALIGNED WITH THE HYPOTHESIS: ARM_OFF is the reference for every delta, and an unarmed agent perseverating longer has its occupancy entropy systematically depressed, inflating every d_* including d_both. The verdict is flippable on a plausible correction, unlike 708's: seed 42 is already neutral, and killing either remaining compound seed yields NEUTRAL. Because a common shift in e_off leaves the max-rule slack invariant, the binding constraint is the absolute floor d_both >= 0.05, requiring e_off to be under-estimated by only 0.1147 nats (seed 44) or 0.1343 nats (seed 43) against 0.1889 and 0.1820 nats of available headroom to the 3-class and 2-class entropy ceilings; e_both on seed 43 is already at its effective two-class ceiling and can only fall. The corrected sign is therefore UNKNOWN -- this is a withdrawal, not a reversal, and levers_compound must not be restated in either direction. Two further defects recorded: selected_class_entropy_nats equals committed_class_entropy_nats to 6dp on all 12 arm-seeds (the line-913 _last_selected_trajectory readout carries zero independent information, so the design's internal cross-check is vacuous), and pre_e3_classes at line 856 is likewise a per-selection quantity read per env step because candidate regeneration is itself e3_tick-gated (agent.py:4812). NOT RECOVERABLE: no custom_information, no per-tick sink, metrics.json is 53 chars, ran on ree-cloud-1 (Phase 3 transports manifest_bytes only -- thrice-confirmed with 785 and 708); the replication factor cannot even be estimated from the record, since n_p2_ticks counts env steps and varies with episode termination. Neither MECH-448 nor MECH-449 loses support: both rest on their own validation gates (689d and 689g respectively), this run is experiment_purpose=diagnostic, promotes nothing, and its evidence_direction was already non_contributory on both claims -- so no epistemic_category is cleared and no confidence moves. Routes to queue-experiment for a corrected V3-EXQ-699b using the clear-before-select pattern of v3_exq_785a. SEE ALSO: the in-flight V3-EXQ-699a is a FAITHFUL re-run of this driver and will reproduce every defect above.

learning_extracted: The 708 defect class has a SECOND form that the validate_experiments lint does not see. The lint keys on last_score_diagnostics; 699's load-bearing exposure is the committed action itself, read per env step at driver line 882. Any driver that accumulates a per-step statistic from the RETURN VALUE of select_action inherits hold-duration weighting without touching a diagnostics latch at all. The affected-corpus sweep should be re-run against this signature, not only the latch read.

Freshness and replication are INDEPENDENT defects, and conflating them mis-adjudicates in both directions. 699's diagnostics are fresh per select() (reassigned at e3_selector.py:2452) yet still replicated per env step; 708's were neither. Because 699's are fresh, an exactly-1.0 active_frac is strong evidence the gate fired every tick -- whereas under 708's genuine latch the same 1.0 would be vacuous. The commissioning chip read 699's 1.0 as the 708 signature and drew the wrong inference from a correct observation.

Construct mismatch, not staleness, is the general hazard: occupancy-weighted != per-decision. A DV can be a perfectly genuine measurement of one thing (behavioural occupancy) and an invalid measurement of the thing the claim is about (selection diversity). Ask what the MECHANISM acts on -- MECH-448/449 act at selection -- and require the readout's sampling unit to match it.

Contamination ALIGNED with the hypothesis is categorically worse than contamination that is merely large. 708 was condemned by a mechanistically-backwards SIGN, which is a detector. 699's bias points the SAME way as the effect under test (the unarmed reference arm perseverates, depressing its occupancy entropy, inflating every delta), so there is no sign-check available and the finding cannot be rescued as 'imprecise but directionally right'. Withdrawal, not correction, is the only honest move.

An inflated n is NOT sufficient for contamination and an arm-dependent STEP COUNT is not proof of an arm-dependent REPLICATION FACTOR. 699's n_p2_ticks spans 3.8x within seed 44, but that is episode-termination variance in env steps; the E3 selection count was never recorded, so the replication factor is unobservable. The chip over-claimed here. Record n_fresh_select / n_latched as telemetry so this is a measured quantity rather than an argued one.

When two supposedly independent readouts agree to the last decimal on every cell, that is a defect signature, not a validation. selected_class_entropy_nats == committed_class_entropy_nats on all 12 arm-seeds revealed that the secondary readout carried no information -- an internal cross-check that looked like corroboration and was actually the same number twice.

A defective instrument can leave the PASS correct while destroying the FINDING, and the two must be adjudicated separately. 699's load-bearing criterion is readiness-only, so the PASS is genuinely untouched; the composition verdict it is remembered for is not. Adjudicating at the level of 'the run' would have thrown away a sound readiness result or preserved an unsound composition claim.

Threshold-invariance is the reusable test for whether a gate survives this defect class, and a floor of literally 0.0 is the strongest form of it. 708 established it for exact zeros; 699 extends it to strictly-positive tests and to saturated fractions at exactly 1.0. Gates stated as 'greater than 0' or that saturate are safe; continuous margins against a non-trivial floor are not.
